content.text:
We will carry out a full bathroom refurbishment in the upstairs bathroom, beginning with a complete strip-out of the existing fittings. Once cleared, we will install the new bath with shower over, basin and pedestal, and toilet, all from the suite you will be supplying, along with wall tiling to approximately 14m² using your tiles and a swap of the existing radiator for a heated towel rail. All making good is included within the scope of work; decorating is not.

Please note that the condition of the soil stack cannot be assessed until the room is opened up — if remedial work to the stack is required, this will be costed separately as a provisional sum and agreed with you before proceeding. We would also ask you to confirm that the bathroom suite and wall tiles will be on site and ready before work begins.
